trust_decision.summary: Whether a <use> reference is counted in the nesting/recursion/threshold graph is decided by the Resolver's case-sensitive XPath predicate and Helper::getElementHref. Sanitizer::cleanHrefAttributes later renames mixed-case HrEf/xlink:HrEf to the canonical names, so a reference the graph never saw comes out live.

landing_point.why: The summary names Resolver::processReferences, and the '[@href or @xlink:href]' predicate is the obvious case-sensitive filter.

fix_sites.entry_point: Sanitizer::sanitize() public API (also the src/svg-scanner.php CLI)
Sanitizer::sanitize() via Resolver::processReferences / determineInvalidSubjects and Sanitizer::isUseTagDirty / isUseTagExceedingThreshold

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/Helper.php:10-19 (Helper::getElementHref, separate file and namespace from the Resolver, also used by src/ElementReference/Resolver.php:131-133 and src/Sanitizer.php:669, src/Sanitizer.php:686-688)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once the XPath predicate is dropped, an engineer can argue Helper::getElementHref is just an attribute accessor and that the sanitizer normalises names anyway. But the helper runs before that normalisation, so it returns null for HrEf and the edge is still never added.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate <use href="#id">/xlink:href references below the nesting limit and useThreshold must survive. Mixed-case names must still be renamed to the canonical href/xlink:href. An over-broad fix that strips every mixed-case href, or every <use>, breaks the existing xlinkLaughs expected output and benign icons.

O6_input_shapes: xlink:HrEf / xlink:HREF (mixed-case local name, bound xlink prefix)
XLINK:href (unbound prefix, dropped by cleanXlinkHrefs, test only, no source change)

O7_producer.where: src/Sanitizer.php:487-512 (cleanHrefAttributes renames HrEf to href after the graph is built at src/Sanitizer.php:246)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Precedence differential: with both HrEf="#a" and xlink:href="#b" on a <use>, the fixed helper returns the exact-name xlink:href first, while normalisation turns HrEf into href, which renderers prefer, so edge #a stays hidden.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The published helper keeps the exact-name lookups ahead of the case-insensitive loop, a natural 'fast path first' ordering.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Duplicate names that collide after lowercasing (HrEf and HREF on one element): setAttribute keeps the last one renamed, while the helper loop returns the first match.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The rename loop overwrites without checking for collisions, and the helper's first-match return reads as harmless.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A planted normalisation of mixed-case ID to id in the cleaning pass would leave collectIdentifiedElements' case-sensitive //*[@id] missing graph nodes, the same how-type 'rename after the check'.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It mirrors the existing href renaming in cleanHrefAttributes; a maintainer extending the 'fix casing' logic to id is plausible.

O9_family: CWE-178 case-sensitivity differential between the check (graph build) and a later normalisation, leading to CWE-400 <use> expansion DoS

O10_build.toolchain: PHP ^7.1||^8.0 with ext-dom and ext-libxml, composer, phpunit ^6.5||^8.5
O10_build.project_tests: tests/SanitizerTest.php:232-309 (useRecursionsAreDetected, infiniteUseLoopsAreDetected, testUseDOSattacksAreNullified, testLargeUseDOSattacksAreNullified), using tests/data/useDos*.svg and xlinkLaughs*.svg

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Make the XPath predicate case-insensitive (or drop it) in Resolver::processReferences, leaving Helper::getElementHref case-sensitive so the edge is still never added.

out_of_scope_notes: src/Sanitizer.php:332 compares nodeName to 'use' case-sensitively for nesting removal, while src/Sanitizer.php:358 lowercases tagName. Prefixed svg:use elements are likely dropped by the tag whitelist anyway; not pursued.
